summary.text: Leah Longest is the Republican candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Chris Odneal in a race with no incumbent.
She is a member of the Grove Elementary School District school board.

paragraphs.text: Longest holds Office 3 on the Grove Elementary School District school board in Oklahoma, and her current term ends in 2027.
Her Republican primary for District 26 was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
